Good quality for both eat-in or take-away - order their eel, barbeque, hotpot, etc...
Nov 2023 • Family
Love their good quality food that had over 60 outlets in Japan:
- famously tender and well-marinated teriyaki eel (fried eel was great too!),
- numerous selection for barbequed items such as chicken and chicken organs,
- on-the-spot blow-torched melting cheese on their tamago (sweet omelet) or eel,
- rice or hotpot dish served on hot stone bowls...

Even for delivery, their food was presented well in good quality packaging.

We also liked their new outlet at Nguyen Thi Thap at District 7 - it looked small from their road-facing shopfront, but it was a gigantic half-football field, double-storied, fully immersive mini-Japan atmosphere they created at this outlet. Not only did my kids love running around the wooden booths created to look like Japanese pavilions, they also provided numerous activities for families, such as:
- Shinto handwashing area (like those at Japanese shrines)
- free kimonos, yukatas and even masks for dress-up and photo-taking
- Kendama (traditional Japanese wooden cup and stringed ball game)
- ring toss game
- rubber gun shooting game
- ceramic-models painting
- candy floss machine
- etc.
- Nearing Christmas, they even transformed one of the booth seats into a mini "winter snow play" area for the littles ones to toss up some fake (cotton) snow. Cute.
